met_analysis:
The Depression over north Chhattisgarh & adjoining Northeast Madhya Pradesh moved north-northwestwards with a speed of 13 kmph during past 06 hours and lies centered at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 26th September 2026 over Northeast Madhya Pradesh & adjoining north Chhattisgarh, near latitude 23.4°N and longitude 81.7°E, about 70 km north-northwest of Pendra Road (Chhattisgarh), 110 km south of Sidhi (Madhya Pradesh) and 230 km south of Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh). It is very likely to move north-northwestwards towards southeast Uttar Pradesh across northeast Madhya Pradesh as a depression till evening of 26th September. Continuing to move further north-northwestwards, it is very likely to weaken gradually into a Well-Marked low pressure area during subsequent 12 hours.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 74°E to the north of Lat. 26°N.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over south Thailand & adjoining Myanmar and extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
